note: Attacker-controlled box.length == 8 (from the ftyp box header) yields boxData.size() == 0; the box content is empty.
The undersized (empty) boxData vector is handed to the File Type box validator.
Unsigned underflow: with boxData.size()==0, 0-8u wraps to 2^64-8, which is divisible by 4, so the size validation passes instead of rejecting the undersized box.
N is computed from the wrapped size and becomes a huge value (2^61-ish), so execution proceeds as if the box were valid.
getULong reads 4 bytes starting at boxData.data() of an empty (0-size) vector: heap-buffer-overflow read of 4 bytes past the allocation.
